body: REDGARDEN commit 912cdff. Commit 62ca556's run hung 18+ minutes on the mingw-w64/SDL2 install step with identical YAML to four immediately-preceding passing runs -- a transient runner/mirror stall, not a code bug. No gh CLI/token available to cancel remotely, and the workflow had no timeout at all (GitHub default job ceiling is 6 hours). Added timeout-minutes: 30 job-level, timeout-minutes: 10 on the specific step, DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive, and a real wget --timeout=30. Closes BACKLOG S170-84.
title: CI hang on rebrand commit diagnosed, hardened with real timeouts
